about_the_game:
Calorie Mate has created a game!

And the second edition is here at last! This year it’s JELLY!
Transform into a Calorie Mate JELLY
and deliver nutrition to a game creator immersed in work.
This action-adventure takes you on a journey through an apartment room.

About the Game
You control a Calorie Mate JELLY pouch that has jumped out of the fridge and guide it toward the goal.
To complete the game, your pouch must reach the hand of the game creator in the workroom deep in [KG1] the apartment.
The JELLY’s temperature will rise with time and other factors.
Try to get it to the goal at as chilled a temperature as possible.
As you go, various obstacles will block the JELLY and threaten its power gauge.
When the gauge hits zero, the game is over.

Video Streaming Guidelines
・Streaming is permitted without prior approval.
・Monetization of content using images from this game is permitted only when using the functions provided by the video streaming website.
・We assume no responsibility for damages of any kind incurred through streaming of video from this game.
(This game is available for a limited time until December 31, 2025.)

Message

Creating a game

requires diverse talents.

 

We want to create unseen worlds with our teammates

who share the same dream but bring different abilities.

 

That hope along with nutrition

will become the driving force for immersion.

 

CONTINUE TO CREATE

 

CalorieMate FOR GAME CREATORS

- JELLY MISSION -
